== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page, drafted from old Players Committee forum posts.

=== Sources used ===
* Players Committee forum topic 4120, "Mystic Visions 4.12 - December 11, 2004 - 27 Hours of Gaming", posts 56482, 58215 (refs <code>pcf-4120-…</code>).
* Players Committee 2004/2005 events listing (ref <code>pc-events05</code>, reused from [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]).

=== Missing data ===
* Attendance and full standings are not in the captured topic.
* Bill Kafer's final place is not given (he went 3–3).

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Kafer wrote "jared Konsker" and said he could not spell the surname; linked to [[Jarad Konsker]].
* Kafer was not sure whether the drain card in Konsker's QMC deck was the Breath Mask, so it was left out.

=== Marginal cuts ===
* Scott Lingrell's post that he would drive in with Kafer and Shaw.
* dr_divot's DeckTech tournament report (no checked copy).

=== Build notes ===
* Title follows the World Championship season naming of [[2005 Endor Regional]] and the List row "Coruscant Regional" under 2005; a redirect from "2004 Coruscant Regionals" is drafted.
